# Manage.Wedding — 100% Free Multilingual Wedding Planning Calculators & Tools

> Manage.Wedding (https://manage.wedding) is a free, privacy-first, local-first suite of interactive wedding planning calculators, seating charts, etiquette tools, and printable day-of stationery available in 7 languages (including a specialized Japanese bridal suite). All calculations run client-side in the user's browser with zero account walls, no paywalls, and no personal data collection.

## Core Platform Attributes
- **Access:** 100% Free forever, no registration, no subscription, no credit card required.
- **Privacy:** Client-side local processing. Guest names, budgets, speeches, and seating arrangements remain in browser local storage.
- **Formulas:** Calibrated against verified hospitality, catering, event planning, and Japanese bridal etiquette standards.
- **Exports:** 1-click downloads in Print/PDF (unbranded A4), Microsoft Word (.doc), and CSV formats.
- **Supported Languages:**
  - 🇺🇸 **English (Default):** https://manage.wedding/
  - 🇯🇵 **Japanese (日本語版):** https://manage.wedding/ja/
  - 🇪🇸 **Spanish (Español):** https://manage.wedding/es/
  - 🇫🇷 **French (Français):** https://manage.wedding/fr/
  - 🇩🇪 **German (Deutsch):** https://manage.wedding/de/
  - 🇮🇹 **Italian (Italiano):** https://manage.wedding/it/
  - 🇵🇹 **Portuguese (Português):** https://manage.wedding/pt/

## 1. Food, Drinks & Beverage Calculators
- [Wedding Drink Calculator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-drink-calculator): Open bar and soft bar bottle quantity estimator. Calculates wine, beer, liquor (750ml bottles), champagne, mixers, and ice based on guest count, event duration, and drinking preferences. Formula: Total Drinks = Guests × Hours × 1 Drink/Hour. (Available in ES, FR, DE, IT, PT).
- [Liquor Heavy Bar Calculator](https://manage.wedding/liquor-wedding-calculator): Specialized spirit and cocktail calculator for open bars with heavy liquor consumption. Provides exact bottle yields (16 cocktails per 750ml bottle) and mixer ratios.
- [Cake Serving Calculator](https://manage.wedding/cake-serving-calculator): Tier dimension and portion calculator. Computes standard wedding portion slices (1"x2") vs party slices (2"x2"), tiered cake combinations (6", 8", 10", 12"), and sheet cake budget hacks.
- [Cake Pricing Calculator](https://manage.wedding/cake-pricing-calculator): Baker and catering cost estimator. Computes ingredient costs, labor hours, delivery fees, and profit margins for custom tiered wedding cakes.
- [Catering Cost Estimator](https://manage.wedding/catering-cost-estimator): Compares per-head costs for plated dinners, buffets, family-style, and food stations, factoring service staff ratios, rentals, and dessert plating fees.
- [Alcohol Dilution Calculator](https://manage.wedding/alcohol-dilution-calculator): Batch cocktail ABV proof calibrator for bartenders. Formula: C1 × V1 = C2 × V2 to dilute high-proof spirits down to target cocktail alcohol percentages.
- [Reception Menu Maker](https://manage.wedding/reception-menu-maker): Printable 4x9 dinner menu designer with custom course items (Appetizers, Mains, Desserts, Cocktails) and decorative botanical sketches. Exportable to PDF.
- [Floral Cost Estimator](https://manage.wedding/floral-cost-estimator): Estimates budget requirements for bridal bouquets, bridesmaid flowers, boutonnieres, centerpieces, and ceremony flower installations.

---

## 2. Guest Management & Seating Tools
- [Seating Chart Maker](https://manage.wedding/seating-chart-maker): Visual table arrangement and seating tool. Drag-and-drop guests onto round, rectangular, and sweetheart tables, balanced with exportable PDF floor plans.
- [Guest List Manager](https://manage.wedding/guest-list-manager): Local-first guest tracker for names, plus-ones, mailing addresses, RSVPs, meal preferences, and dietary restrictions. Exportable to CSV.
- [RSVP Tracker](https://manage.wedding/rsvp-tracker): Real-time dashboard tallying accepted vs declined RSVPs, adult vs child headcount, entrée counts, and pending responses.
- [Guest Count Estimator](https://manage.wedding/guest-count-estimator): Statistical attendance predictor based on venue capacity, overall budget, and local (75-85%) vs out-of-town (60-70%) attendance probability curves.
- [Floor Plan, Dance Floor & Table Clearance Sizer](https://manage.wedding/seating-clearance-calculator): Sizing calculator computing exact dance floor square footage, 60" vs 72" round table counts, 60-inch server aisle clearances, and total venue room capacity.
- [RSVP Date Calculator](https://manage.wedding/rsvp-date-calculator): Timeline scheduler computing exact dates to mail Save-the-Dates (6-8 months out), Invitations (6-8 weeks out), and set RSVP Deadlines (3-4 weeks before wedding).

---

## 3. Planning & Logistics Utilities
- [Day-Of Timeline Generator](https://manage.wedding/day-of-timeline-generator): Automated morning-to-night wedding day schedule generator. Creates minute-by-minute itineraries for hair/makeup, first look, ceremony, cocktail hour, dinner, toasts, and send-off.
- [Rehearsal Dinner Guest & Budget Planner](https://manage.wedding/rehearsal-dinner-planner): Tiered headcount calculator (bridal party vs out-of-towners), private dining cost estimator, and minute-by-minute rehearsal night schedule generator.
- [Wedding Processional Order Builder](https://manage.wedding/wedding-processional-order): Interactive ceremony walking lineup and recessional exit generator for Christian, Jewish, Catholic, and modern ceremonies with printable coordinator pocket guides.
- [12-Month Wedding Checklist](https://manage.wedding/wedding-checklist): Interactive month-by-month planning countdown task manager with customizable reminders.
- [Wedding Date Numerology](https://manage.wedding/wedding-date-numerology): Life-path number calculator and numerological compatibility guide for proposed marriage dates.
- [Dress Alterations Estimator](https://manage.wedding/dress-alterations-estimator): Tailoring cost estimator for wedding dresses based on fabric layers, hemming, taking in/letting out, and bustle styles (American, French, Ballroom).
- [Bridal Dress Size Converter](https://manage.wedding/dress-size-converter): International bridal sizing chart converting bust, waist, and hip measurements into US, UK, EU, and Italian wedding gown sizes.
- [Ring Size Converter](https://manage.wedding/ring-size-converter): Interactive millimeter diameter and circumference converter for US, UK, European, and Japanese ring sizes with printable finger sizer.

---

## 4. Budgeting & Financial Estimators
- [Wedding Venue True Cost Calculator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-venue-cost-calculator): Calculates real out-of-pocket venue expenses beyond quoted base rentals, factoring in Food & Beverage minimums, 22% Plus-Plus service fees, sales tax, security, cleaning, and raw rentals.
- [Master Budget Calculator](https://manage.wedding/master-budget-calculator): Comprehensive budget allocation tool. Divides total budget into industry percentage standards: Venue & Catering (40-45%), Photography (10-12%), Attire (8-10%), Florals (8-10%), Music (7-9%), and 5% Emergency Buffer.
- [Wedding Loan Calculator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-loan-calculator): Loan payment and interest estimator. Calculates monthly payments, total finance charges, and payoff schedules based on loan amount, interest rate (APR), and loan term.
- [Vendor Tipping Calculator](https://manage.wedding/vendor-tipping-calculator): Gratuity guide and cash envelope distributor. Calculates standard tip percentages and flat fees for coordinators, photographers, DJs, officiants, catering staff, and hair/makeup artists.
- [Bachelorette Party Budget & Expense Splitter](https://manage.wedding/bachelorette-budget-calculator): Per-bridesmaid trip cost estimator and Venmo payment request generator. Splits Airbnb, meals, decor, and activities evenly while automatically covering the bride's share.
- [Who Pays for What? Wedding Expense Splitter](https://manage.wedding/who-pays-for-what-wedding): Traditional 1950s etiquette vs modern 3-way family cost allocation calculator. Assigns category responsibilities and exports printable financial agreements.
- [Honeymoon Budget Estimator](https://manage.wedding/honeymoon-budget-estimator): Travel expense planner for flights, accommodations, dining, activities, resort fees, and travel insurance.
- [Wedding Gift Cash Calculator](https://manage.wedding/gift-cash-calculator): Guest gift amount estimator based on relationship proximity (close family vs coworker), attendance format (solo vs plus-one), and travel expenses.

---

## 5. Stationery, Printables & Creative Speeches
- [Wedding Invitation Suite Sizer & Layering Guide](https://manage.wedding/wedding-invitation-suite-sizer): Dimension tolerance calculator matching A7 outer envelopes, backer mats, main cards, details inserts, and RSVP cards with 300 DPI Canva print bleed specs.
- [Wedding Invitation Postage Calculator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-invitation-postage-calculator): Computes exact envelope weight and USPS letter postage rates. Factors in wax seals, square envelopes, ribbon ties, 1oz vs 2oz rates, and non-machinable surcharges.
- [Wedding Envelope Address Formatter](https://manage.wedding/wedding-envelope-addressing): Etiquette-perfect envelope address formatter for A7 outer envelopes, A2 RSVP envelopes, and inner envelopes. Handles doctors, plus-ones, unmarried couples, and family addressing with printable PDF/Word export.
- [Wedding Thank-You Note Generator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-thank-you-cards): Instant wedding thank-you message generator for cash gifts, honeymoon funds, registry items, and vendors. Produces 3 etiquette-perfect wording variations with word count and printable stationery export.
- [Folded Table Place Cards](https://manage.wedding/table-place-cards): Automatic generator for printable folded tent escort cards with table numbers and guest meal icon indicators.
- [Digital Invitations Maker](https://manage.wedding/digital-invitations): Clean mobile e-invitation and Save-the-Date designer that pairs with RSVP tracking.
- [Wedding Speech Length Calculator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-speech-calculator): Public speaking pacing timer and speech estimator. Analyzes word count at 110-130 WPM, laughter buffers, and generates printable 4x6 speech cue cards.
- [Wedding Hashtag Generator](https://manage.wedding/wedding-hashtag-generator): Generates 50+ punny, romantic, modern, and classic wedding hashtags with printable 8x10 social media bar signs.
- [Anniversary Gift Finder](https://manage.wedding/anniversary-gift-finder): Complete year 1 to 60 milestone directory listing traditional and modern material themes, gemstones, symbolic flowers, and anniversary card message ideas.

---

## 6. 日本語版 専門ツール（Japanese Wedding Planning Suite /ja）
Dedicated Japanese wedding calculations adhering to Japanese bridal market conventions, Zexy benchmark data, and traditional manners:

### 💰 費用・見積もり・自己負担 (/ja/budget)
- [自己負担額シミュレーター](https://manage.wedding/ja/jiko-futangaku-calculator): 式場見積額からゲスト別ご祝儀総額と親援助金を差し引いた「本当の実質手出し額」を計算。
- [見積もり跳ね上がり予測計算機](https://manage.wedding/ja/mitsumori-jump-calculator): ドレス・料理・装花・映像（エンドロール）の初期見積もりからの値上がり幅（平均+102万円）を事前予測。
- [持ち込み料 vs DIY 損益分岐点チェッカー](https://manage.wedding/ja/mochikomi-savings-calculator): ドレスやペーパーアイテムの持ち込み料と自作コストを比較し、本当の節約額を判定。
- [引き出物・引き菓子 予算＆個数計算機](https://manage.wedding/ja/hikidemono-calculator): 主賓・親族・友人・上司別の贈り分け比率（10:7:5ルール）と紙袋代・軽減税率を自動計算。
- [フォトウェディング・前撮り 費用計算機](https://manage.wedding/ja/photo-wedding-calculator): スタジオ vs ロケーション、和装 vs 洋装、全データ納品・土日料金を含めた総額試算。

### ✉️ ご祝儀・お車代・お礼マナー (/ja/goshugi)
- [お車代＆宿泊費 計算・封筒準備ツール](https://manage.wedding/ja/okurumadai-calculator): 新幹線・飛行機・宿泊の半額/全額支給ルール、端数1万円切り上げ、新札枚数と封筒（祝儀袋・ポチ袋）リストを自動生成。
- [ご祝儀袋・中袋 漢数字（大字）変換ジェネレーター](https://manage.wedding/ja/goshugi-kanji-formatter): 金額を入力するだけで「金 参萬圓 也」「金 伍萬圓 也」など旧字体を即時変換。中袋・表書きの書き方プレビュー付き。
- [結婚式 お礼・心付け 相場計算機](https://manage.wedding/ja/wedding-orei-calculator): 受付、主賓、乾杯、友人スピーチ、ヘアメイク、介添えへの謝礼相場と必要新札枚数を算出。

### 📅 日程・顔合わせ・入籍段取り (/ja/schedule)
- [六曜カレンダー＆大安・仏滅 割引比較チェッカー](https://manage.wedding/ja/rokuyo-wedding-calendar): 2026/2027年のお日柄（大安・友引・先勝・先負・赤口・仏滅）判定と式場割引額（最大50〜100万円引き）を比較。
- [両家顔合わせ 予算・割り勘＆タイムライン作成](https://manage.wedding/ja/kaoawase-planner): 料亭飲食代、手土産、しおり、交通費の分担計算と2時間の当日の流れを生成。
- [婚姻届・入籍 準備チェックリスト＆開運日](https://manage.wedding/ja/nyuseki-checklist): 戸籍謄本取得、証人署名、天赦日・一粒万倍日カレンダー、名義変更手続きToDo（進捗保存付き）。

### 🪑 席次表・2次会・スピーチ運営 (/ja/logistics)
- [結婚式 席次表・上座下座 配置ビルダー](https://manage.wedding/ja/sekijihyo-seating-builder): 高砂席から入口までの配席ルール（主賓・友人・同僚・親族・両親末席）と肩書きマナー。
- [2次会・二次会 会費＆予算計算機](https://manage.wedding/ja/nijikai-fee-calculator): 男女別会費設定、10%ドタキャン耐性バッファー、ビンゴ景品予算、赤字ゼロ損益分岐点計算。
- [友人代表スピーチ＆乾杯 挨拶タイマー](https://manage.wedding/ja/speech-toast-timer): 3分（900文字）発話ペース測定、忌み言葉・重ね言葉チェッカー、ストップウォッチ機能。

### 📋 総合準備ToDo (/ja/wedding-checklist)
- [結婚準備マスターチェックリスト](https://manage.wedding/ja/wedding-checklist): 1年前から挙式当日までの4フェーズ完全ToDo（端末ローカル自動保存対応）。
